mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 PM, here is today's balanced dish: conditions are 57 degrees with clear skies near Verona Community Park, beneath a third quarter moon. Air quality is moderate with an AQI of 55. Expect an overnight low of 53 degrees with no rain predicted. The International Space Station makes a pass tonight, but you won't be able to see it due to the clouds.

In city news, Public Works reminds residents that curbside trash and biweekly recycling collections are handled through Pellitteri Waste Systems. You can utilize the city's online Waste Wizard tool to figure out proper e-waste disposal or visit the Verona Recycling Center on Investment Court.

Looking at upcoming events, you can catch live music happening today at Bailey's Run Vineyard, or drop in tomorrow for yoga at Insight Wellness. Looking ahead to next week, trivia nights will be hosted on Tuesday at Hop Haus Brewing Company and Lake Lou-ee.

In police news, on Saturday morning officers responded to Plympton Street and Rita Avenue for a vehicle stopped at the intersection, where a 40-year-old Verona man was arrested for an O W I first offence.
Finally, Culver's is closed for the night after serving up Caramel Fudge Cookie Dough. The doors open tomorrow at 10:00 AM, featuring tomorrow's flavor of the day, Peanut Butter Fudge Brownie.
